scripts.build:all: npm run build:pages && npm run build:background && npm run build:content && npm run build:passkeys
scripts.build:passkeys: vite build --config vite.passkey-bridge.config.ts && vite build --config vite.passkey-provider.config.ts
scripts.package: npm run build && rm -f claspt-extension-$npm_package_version.zip && (cd dist && zip -r -q ../claspt-extension-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '**/*.map') && ls -lh claspt-extension-$npm_package_version.zip
scripts.package:firefox: npm run build && node scripts/firefox-manifest.mjs --write && rm -f claspt-extension-firefox-$npm_package_version.zip && (cd dist && zip -r -q ../claspt-extension-firefox-$npm_package_version.zip . -x '**/*.map') && ls -lh claspt-extension-firefox-$npm_package_version.zip
